content: Majan: “Jesúsja Chiga in'jan'cho Cristo tsu” qquen in'jan'da Chiga du'shu tsu. Majan quitsama in'jan'da tsambe du'shuma'qque tsu in'jan.
Chigama in'jamba tise manda'choma tson'da gi ingi Chiga dushundeccuma in'jan'chove atesu'faya.
Chigama in'jan'chota tsu Tise manda'choma pañaña'cho. Aiye'pambi tsu Tise manda'choma pañamba tson'faye.
Nane poi Chiga dushundeccu tsu va ande'su in'jan'choma patsu'fa. Jesúsve in'jamba gi tsa'caen patsu'fa.
Majan “Jesucristoja Chiga Dutssi'ye” qquen in'jan'cho, tsayi tsu va ande'su a'i in'jan'choma patsu'su.
Cristoja Chiga Dutssi'ye tsu
Jesucristo jisi tsa'ccu, anjampaja tisene canjaen'fa. Fetiyesi tsa'ccu tsu canjaen. Tsa'ma aqquia tsa'ccui'ccuyi canjaembi tsu. Tise anjampa'qque tssamba canjaen.
Chiga Qquendya'pa'qque Jesúsne conda. Tsaja tansintsse conda'su.
Tres condasundeccu tsu jin: Chiga Qquendya'pa, Jesús fetiye'cho tsa'ccu, tise anjampa tssan'cho'qque. Tsa tres tsu fae'ngatsse conda'fa.
A'i su'choma paña'da gi in'jan'fa. Tsa'ma Chiga su'cho tsu bove ñotssi. Chiga Quitsaja tansintsse conda Tise Dutssi'yene.

Nane majan Chiga Dutssi'yeve in'jan'chota tisu injama'choyi tsu Chiga su'choma atesucho. Tsa'ma majan Chigave in'jambi'choa'ta tsu “Chigaja afopa'cho” qquen in'jaña. Tsaja pañañe in'jambi Chiga Quitsa Tise Dutssi'yene tansintsse condase'choma.
Qquen tsu ñoa'me Chiga su'cho: Chigaja tayo inginga antte tsangae canseye. Tise Dutssi'ye tsu cansian'su.
Majan Chiga Dutssi'yeve in'jan'cho tsu tsangae canse'fa. Tsa'ma majan Chiga Dutssi'yeve in'jambi'choa'ta canse'fambi.
Tsangaeyi candusian'cho
Que'i Chiga Dutssi'yeve in'jan'fasi gi que'inga qquen tevaen que'i tisupa Cristoi'ccu tsangae canse'fa'choma atesu'faye.
Tsa'camba gi dyombi'tsse Chigama iñajañe osha'fa. Atesu'fa gi jongoesuve Tise in'janqquia'caen in'jamba afa'nijan Tiseja pañaña.
Tsa'caen iñajamba Tise paña'choma atesu'ta gi atesu'fa tayo tsu Tiseja afe ingi iñajan'choma.

Majan tise faenga'su joqquitssianqque'su egae tsincon'chove tsinconsi atte'ta Chigama iñajaña'cho tisene cuintsu Chiga tsama ccushaeñe. Tsa'caen tsu Chigaja ccushaeña joqquitssianqque'su egae tsincon'chove tsincon'ninda. Majan egae tsincon'choja joqquitssi'masia. Tsane Chigama iñajañe mandambi gi.
Nane pa'cco in'jangae tson'cho tsu egae tsincon'cho. Tsa'ma joqquitssianqque'su egae tsincon'cho'qque tsu jin.
Atesu'fa gi majan Chiga du'shuve da'ta egae tsincomba canse'fambi tsu. Chiga Dutssi'ye tisema coira'jesi egae tsincon'su na'suja tisenga catsembi.
Atesu'fa gi ingija Chigambe'fa gi. Tsa'ma egae tsincon'su na'suja pa'cco ande'su a'ima manda'je.

Toya'caen gi atesu'fa Chiga Dutssi'ye tayo ji'choma. Tsa tsu ingima in'jaen ñoa'me Chigama atesuye. Ingija fae'ngae jincho'fa ñoa'me Chigai'ccu. Toya'caen gi fae'ngae jincho'fa Tise Dutssi'ye Jesuscristoi'ccu. Tsaja ñoa'me Chigayi. Tsai'ccu fae'ngae jincho'ta tsangae canseya'cho tsu.
Dushundeccu, osha'cho afopa'cho chiga'ca'nga nafattu'fajama. Tsangaeyi.
